name: Status Update UI Lab
description: Experimental optional UI wrapper for status updates. Sends one-shot comfortable status cards without editing previous messages.

title.description: Card title. Default: OpenClaw 正在處理

prefix.description: Fallback text prefix. Default: 狀態更新：

silent.description: Send updates silently when supported. Default: true

style.description: presentation uses OpenClaw semantic UI when available; text uses a Markdown fallback card. Default: presentation
